journalist.name: Journalist
journalist.desc: Resourceful and credible, with a better chance of finding Receipts. Starts in Seattle.

organizer.name: Organizer
organizer.desc: Starts with stronger morale and more outside allies; also receives a small bribe discount. Starts in Portland.

whistleblower.name: Whistleblower
whistleblower.desc: Finds more Receipts but draws extra executive-order pressure. Starts in San Francisco.

lobbyist.name: Lobbyist
lobbyist.desc: Receives shop and bribe discounts through contacts. Starts in Los Angeles; this does not grant staff or official authority.

staffer.name: Staffer
staffer.desc: A balanced start without special bonuses or penalties. Starts in Sacramento.

satirist.name: Satirist
satirist.desc: Humor helps sustain sanity. Starts in San Diego.
